information.description:
Humanoid Ground Drone. A humanoid drone: robot hands (BODY 8), two Subdermal Grips, Jump Boosters, LL/IR/UV camera with Targeting Scope. Wields any gun up to BODY 8; usually a Masamune (24 Basic), a Shigure with a Shrieker underbarrel (50 Armor-Piercing) or a Shingen (30 Improved Smart).

Cost: 22,500eb
MOVE: 5
HP: 30
SP: 12
CN: 14
Counter: DV21 E/S Tech, 5 min to counter

Item Compendium (2070) • Gear & Goods

Art: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.
